cimm: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 8

traits.d: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
The jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.d: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage.

reactions.d: When a jelly that is Medium or larger is subjected to lightning or slashing damage, it splits into two new jellies if it has at least 10 hit points. Each new jelly has hit points equal to half the original jelly's, rounded down. New jellies are one size smaller than the original jelly.

tips: Иммунитет к урону: lightning, slashing — не тратьте на это ресурсы, ищите другой тип урона.
Сопротивление урону: acid — вполовину менее эффективно, предпочтите другой тип.
Иммунитет к состояниям: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone — заклинания/эффекты с такими состояниями не подействуют.
Слабый спасбросок: Харизму (-5) — эффекты и заклинания на эту характеристику с высокой вероятностью пройдут.
